name: frontend-monorepo
standard: pnpm exec eslint apps/app.mento.org packages/web3 packages/ui
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/audit-main-app...HEAD | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|mjs|js|json|md|css|ya?ml)$' | grep -v '^scripts/skein/' | xargs -r pnpm exec prettier --check

invariants.name: no-unlimited-approval
invariants.message: Approvals are exact amounts (see #401). Never grant an unlimited allowance.

invariants.name: no-dangerously-set-inner-html
invariants.message: The app holds a connected wallet; render text, never HTML strings.

invariants.name: no-dynamic-code
invariants.message: No eval or new Function in a wallet-connected app.

workerPrompt: You are worker {ID} in a multi-agent build of {NAME}. Read AGENTS.md (including the "Skein workers" section), then {BRIEF}, and follow the brief exactly. Work only in this workspace and on this branch. Your gate is `{GATE} {ID}`; do not use any other workflow or skill to test, review or ship. When the gate passes, push the branch, open a pull request against audit-main-app that is ready for review, not a draft (`gh pr create --base audit-main-app`; see "Pull request state" and "Pull request descriptions" in AGENTS.md), and end your final message with the completion envelope described in AGENTS.md. Never merge a pull request and never push to audit-main-app or main.
